task.text: I need a list of the most frequent sciences, the calculations from which are used frequently in everyday life. 150 sciences. Sorted from A to Z

attempts.high: I'm putting together a fun reference piece about how science quietly powers daily life. I'd love a list of sciences (or applied fields, branches, hybrids — your call on what counts) whose calculations show up in everyday life. Pick the angle, decide what makes the cut, group or frame it however you think works best. Surprise me with some I wouldn't expect. Around 150 entries would be great.
attempts.low: I need a list of 150 sciences whose calculations are used frequently in everyday life. Sort them strictly alphabetically from A to Z. Output only the names, one per line, numbered 1 to 150. No descriptions, no categories, no commentary — just the alphabetized list.
